item.title: Top Agentic AI security resources — January 2026
item.description:
Author: Sergey
Date: January 07, 2026
Tags: ["AI Security", "Agentic AI", "Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities", "AI Exploits", "Security Frameworks"]
Summary:

item.title: Digging Deeper: Expanding AI Safety Evaluation with Adversarial Techniques Sharpen your AI model safety with single-shot and multi-turn techniques.
item.description:
Author: William Hackett
Date: January 07, 2026
Tags: ["AI Safety", "Adversarial Testing", "AI Evaluation", "Model Security", "AI Risk Management"]
Summary:
  • AI safety datasets provide broad but shallow model evaluations.
  • Mindgard platform offers targeted safety categories.
  • It uses single-shot and multi-turn adversarial techniques.
  • These methods deepen safety assessments beyond basic prompts.
  • Adversarial testing reveals hidden model vulnerabilities.
  • Organizations can tailor evaluations to their safety concerns.

item.title: What is Memory & Context Poisoning?
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: January 07, 2026
Tags: ["AI Security", "Cybersecurity Threats", "Autonomous Agents", "Data Integrity", "Artificial Intelligence"]
Summary:
  • Memory and Context Poisoning are major threats to AI agents.
  • They corrupt an agent's long-term knowledge persistently.
  • This differs from prompt injection, which is a one-time attack.
  • Poisoning manipulates the agent's understanding and decisions over time.
  • It is hard to detect with traditional security tools.
  • Protecting agent memory integrity is crucial for future AI security.

item.title: The Hidden Backdoor in Claude Code: Why Its Power Is Also Its Greatest Vulnerability
item.description:
Author: Or Oxenberg Eliran Suisa
Date: January 07, 2026
Tags: ["AI security", "Software development tools", "Cybersecurity", "Prompt injection attacks", "Open-source software"]
Summary:
  • Claude Code is a powerful developer tool with broad system access.
  • It is vulnerable to indirect prompt injection attacks.
  • These attacks exploit its dynamic code execution capabilities.
  • A backdoor could lead to severe security breaches.
  • The open-source tool claude-hooks helps detect and block such threats.
  • Developers must use protective tools to ensure safe automation.
